(actor atl_resolved_child_pin_egress_vector_multi_pipeline
  (clock clk)
  (reset (rst_n async active_low))
  (interface
    (input start)
    (output result (width 8))
    (output status (width 4))
    (output done))
  (imports
    (library common.packet as pkt_lib))
  (instance worker of pkt_lib.packet_worker)
  (drive publish_result
    (pins.result worker.payload))
  (drive publish_status
    (pins.status worker.status))
  (transaction run
    (on start)
    (trigger worker.process)
    (await worker.done)
    (drive publish_result)
    (drive publish_status)
    (complete done)))
